scope: Passive same-exposure native-HD negative of the frozen row9_contact_dev_v1 candidate. The v1.1 test refused 8 mm as UNKNOWN at 640x480 because either bank had fewer than three row-9 transitions. Neither control logic nor classifier thresholds change.
capture: From zero repeat only the depth_noise_0p5 full vision FSM with unchanged control optics and decisions. After the third actual commanded closure, capture one additional 1280x960 RGB-D exposure at the same physical ECM pose on each observe until termination, independently re-estimate scissors and direct slit on that very exposure using a copy of the estimator, and restore the original 640x480 image and sensor readback before the next controller action. Never select by structural length and never feed HD results to control. Preserve raw and noisy HD depth, calibration, optical estimates and separate structural labels. Reject if the live closure/reacquisition/structural tick sequence differs from the prior depth-noise run.
test: Before opening the structural labels, seal every HD optical prediction with the unmodified row9_terminal.py (three transitions per bank, 0.35 mm local comparison). Then score all exposures: require at least two directly visible, qualified 8 mm NOT_STOP frames, zero STOP_CANDIDATE under 9 mm, and the already sealed nominal 9 mm positive at ticks 31/32. UNKNOWN or changed mechanics fails the screen. Passing is development-only, not M5 acceptance or a motion permit.
